brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Upcycled 420-600D packcloth / inner tube / vinyl tarp'. CONFIRMED across the lineup, but it covers two visually very different materials that show up on different products: (1) the Clutch saddle bag and the Cotton Mouth feedbag's body are unmistakably black upcycled bicycle inner-tube rubber - the tire tread/mold texture is directly visible in every Clutch photo (assets/products/green-guru-gear/clutch-clutch-saddle-bag-0-8l-1.jpg, -2.jpg), a matte black rubber, not a woven fabric; (2) the Hauler, Upshift, Fullshift and Tanker are cut from a grid-quilted, slightly shiny ripstop/vinyl-tarp-look face fabric in randomized bright colors (each unit is a one-off patchwork of salvaged tent vinyl/billboard scrap, matching brands.json's 'aesthetic' text). Both materials are covered by the brand fabric string, so it is accurate, but a single rendered material for the whole brand will not read correctly: the Clutch and Cotton Mouth should render as matte black rubber, the other four as the colorful quilted vinyl/ripstop face.
brand_notes.method: Local photos in assets/products/green-guru-gear/ read directly (10 files: 2 each for Hauler, Clutch, Upshift, Fullshift(1), Tanker(1), Cotton Mouth). Maker product pages fetched via curl (Shopify pages return usable server-rendered spec text, no JS scaffolding issue). One local photo (cotton-mouth-cotton-mouth-snack-water-feedbag-2-3l-2.png) is a rear-view trail action shot; a small pack is visible at the rider's lower back but it reads as a hip/lumbar pack worn on the body, not the stem-mounted feedbag itself (which would be up front, out of frame in a rear view) - not used as evidence for the Cotton Mouth's geometry or mount, flagged per-product below.

products.name: Hauler Bike Pack Saddle Bag
products.dims_raw: Dimensions: 9 L x 5 H x 22 D in. (228 x 127 x 558 mm); Capacity: 990 cu in / 16.2 L
products.dims_note: Confirmed verbatim via curl of the live product page (unchanged from prior pass). Green Guru's L/H/D labels are across-bike-width / height / fore-aft-depth (confirmed by the Clutch's 3L x 3.5H x 5D matching a small saddle bag exactly), so the 22in D figure is len. Only one figure is published (no min/max range), and 9x5x22in = 990cu in matches the stated 16.2L capacity exactly, i.e. this is already the packed/rated-capacity figure - the new unfurled/min-height rule has nothing to override here.

geometry.notes: Classic bikepacking saddle bag silhouette: squared shoulder at the saddle-rail nose, body stays fairly full-width back to a roll-top tail (mild taper, not a sharp point). Colors are randomized per unit - the two photographed samples (blue/white/red panels with a tan triangle, and an all-orange quilted sample) share the same cut and hardware but no two Hauler bags are dyed the same; render should not assume a fixed colorway.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle cinching the roll, mid-body

details.fabric: grid-quilted vinyl/ripstop-look face over a black base panel - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Nose strapped hard to the saddle rails with a stabilizing wrap to the seatpost; tail hangs clear behind the seatpost, roll-top end away from the bike.

colorways.name: Randomized upcycled patchwork (no two bags identical)

products.name: Clutch Saddle Bag
products.dims_raw: Dimensions: 3 L x 3.5 H x 5 D in. (76.2 x 88.9 x 127 mm); Capacity: 52 cu in / 0.8 L
products.dims_note: Confirmed verbatim via curl. Same L=width-across-bike / H=height / D=fore-aft-length convention as the Hauler. Only one figure published; box volume (0.86L) matches the stated 0.8L capacity almost exactly, so this is already the packed figure.

geometry.notes: Small stubby dome/wedge, nearly as deep vertically as it is wide - a chunky pouch, not an elongated bag (confirmed against the 1.43 length:height ratio). Flat back face rides against the underside of the saddle and seatpost.

closure.hardware: single slider, green paracord pull toggle

details.fabric: upcycled bicycle inner-tube rubber - tire tread/mold texture is directly visible in both photos, the clearest example of the 'inner tube' component of the brand fabric string anywhere in this catalogue

mount.notes: Tiny wedge sits tucked high and tight under the saddle nose, does not project far below the rails.

colorways.name: Randomized upcycled inner-tube black + accent trim

products.name: Upshift Frame Bag
products.dims_note: Confirmed verbatim via curl (page also gives frame-fit numbers: 15in toptube, 6.5in downtube, 11in toptube-to-seatpost, 3in headtube - a sizing guide, not the bag's own outer dims, so not used here). Photo 1 (flat studio shot) is a clean right triangle whose 15in top edge and 9in drop match the published L/H exactly. Green Guru's own arithmetic confirms it: 15 x 9 x 2.5in = 337.5 cu in, and they publish 168.7 cu in, exactly half the bounding box, consistent with a flat triangular panel bag. No range published, so nothing to override under the new rule.

geometry.notes: Right-triangle half-frame bag: long top edge runs under the top tube, short vertical edge drops at the head-tube/seat-post junction, hypotenuse angles down toward the bottom bracket. On-bike photo (upshift-...-2.png) confirms mount just under the top tube, wedge hanging into the front triangle.

closure.hardware: single slider, offset slightly below the top edge, paracord pull tab

details.fabric: grid-quilted ripstop/vinyl-tarp-look face (orange sample photographed); Earthtone and Camo colorways also offered - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: 3 hook-and-loop wraps cinch the top edge to the top tube; 2 more wraps on the diagonal edge cinch to the down tube near the head tube. Right-angle corner sits forward-up at the head-tube junction per the on-bike photo.

products.name: Fullshift Frame Bag
products.dims_raw: 600x Medium: 20.5" TT x 23.4" DT x 12.5" SP x 3" / 2.8L
products.dims_note: curl of the live product page did not return the spec text this time (JS-rendered tab on this page); dims left unchanged from the prior verified pass, which read the size string verbatim. This is a full triangle sized by frame-tube lengths (TT/DT/SP = top tube / down tube / seat post reach), so the bounding box (~2x the fabric volume) is expected. Note the maker's own litres-vs-box ratio is inconsistent with the Upshift: the Upshift publishes exactly half its bounding box as capacity, but applying that same rule here gives ~6.3L against the stated 2.8L - so treat the 2.8L capacity figure, not the dims, as the doubtful number on this product.

geometry.notes: Full main-triangle frame bag, long top edge along the top tube, full vertical drop to the bottom bracket area, squared corners at the head-tube and seat-tube junctions. Only one (front 3/4 studio) photo available - no on-bike shot, so exact strap placement and the reverse-face pocket are inferred rather than directly confirmed; confidence set to medium for that reason.

details.fabric: grid-quilted ripstop/vinyl-tarp-look face (orange sample photographed); Pink/Purple and Earthtone colorways also offered - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Fills the front triangle; strap count and the side pocket's visibility are inferred from the same hardware family as the smaller Upshift, not confirmed by an on-bike photo of this specific product.

products.name: Tanker Top Tube Bag
products.dims_raw: 9 L x 4 H x 3 D inches (228.6 x 101.6 x 76.2 mm); no capacity published
products.dims_note: curl of the live product page returned no spec text this time (JS-rendered); dims left unchanged from the prior pass. Green Guru publishes no litre figure for the Tanker; 9x4x3in = 108 cu in = 1.77L, so 1.8L capacity is derived from the maker's own dims, not stated by them.

geometry.notes: Side-profile photo shows a wedge that is tall at the rear (saddle-facing) end and slopes low at the front (stem-facing) end to clear the rider's knees while pedaling. Only one photo available, no maker studio/on-bike shots, no visible logo in the crop - confidence set to medium.

closure.hardware: single slider, paracord toggle pull at the rear-top corner

details.fabric: grid-quilted ripstop/vinyl-tarp-look face, color-blocked panels visible in the photographed sample - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Straddles the top tube between saddle and stem; only a single rear underside strap is clearly visible in the one available photo - a second front strap is typical for this bag style but not confirmed here.

products.name: Cotton Mouth Snack/Water Feedbag
products.dims_raw: 4.5 L x 7 H x 4.5 D inches (114.3 x 177 x 114.3 mm); 141 cu in / 2.3 liters
products.dims_note: Confirmed verbatim via curl. Upright square-section feed bag, 4.5in on both horizontal axes, 7in tall; only one figure published, no range.

geometry.notes: Upright quilted-square body with a drawcord-cinched collar at the top, not a true roll-top. Insulated with upcycled sleeping-pad foam per maker copy. The second local photo (cotton-mouth-...-2.png) is a rear-view trail action shot; the pack visible near the rider's lower back reads as a hip/lumbar pack worn on the body, not this stem-mounted feedbag (which mounts up front, out of frame in a rear view) - NOT used as evidence here.

closure.hardware: single cordlock toggle cinching the collar

details.fabric: insulated quilted-diamond-stitch face in randomized upcycled colors (green/orange/black sample photographed) over a mesh front pocket - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Upright feedbag, back panel strapped against the stem/head-tube area; exact strap routing (single wrap vs. wrap-plus-cable-loop) not confirmed - only a studio photo available, hence medium confidence.
